items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1957-multiple
items.q: Jazz Piuma? I'll play some one. He lived right at 35th and State.

ctx.x: I've seen those things, but I never heard about his records.

Oh yeah, man. He's still making records. But I can't think of his first name now. Jazz Piuma? I'll play some one. He lived right at 35th and State. Tampa Red used to live along in there. That's the man I'm trying to call, Tampa Ray. But, but, but, but, uh, never to call him Tampa Ray. Yeah. But his real name is Roosevelt. Oh, is that right? I never do. Yeah. Tampa Ray, yes then. I thought his name was Hudson Whittaker. He put a harmonic in his mouth and put a guitar back there. I thought his name was Hudson…

No, then Mama Yancey used to call him Mrs. She'd meet and say, I saw Mrs. Tampa over at the market yesterday at the store. Mrs. Tampa. He used to record for Lester Melrose, and Lester always owed him royalties and so on. They'd get together. Yeah.
